now.summary: Building deep, hands-on foundations in PyTorch, Transformers, and LLMs from scratch while keeping algorithm skills sharp in English and pushing Japanese listening/speaking from N2 to interview-ready fluency before arriving in Kyoto.

tracks.title: Deep Learning & LLM From Scratch
tracks.detail: Karpathy Zero-to-Hero → PyTorch Transformer/RoPE/GQA → Stanford CS224N & CS336 core lectures.

tracks.title: Algorithms (NeetCode 150 · English)
tracks.detail: 1–2 problems daily with Think-Aloud English notes for foreign tech SWE/MLE interviews.

tracks.title: Japanese Listening & Speaking
tracks.detail: 30 min/day shadowing + weekly conversation practice + technical project pitch scripts.

tracks.title: Kyoto NLP Lab Paper Reading
tracks.detail: Surveying 2025–2026 ACL/EMNLP/EACL papers from Murawaki, Chu, and Cheng groups.

readingShelf.title: Andrej Karpathy — Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
Stanford CS224N & CS336 (Language Modeling from Scratch)
KyotoU NLP Lab 2025–2026 ACL / EACL / EMNLP Proceedings

phases.title: Pre-Enrollment Sprint (Zero → Research-Ready)
phases.goal: Arrive in Kyoto able to read modern LLM papers fluently, write clean PyTorch training/inference code, and communicate comfortably in both English and Japanese.

items.title: Launch Public English AI/NLP Learning Site & GitHub Pages Pipeline
items.detail: Built Astro + KaTeX site with Writing, Timeline, and Now & Plan pages to log all pre-enrollment progress in English.

items.title: Build GPT-2 & Core LLM Modules from Scratch in PyTorch
items.detail: Hand-code micrograd, causal MHA/GQA, KV cache, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, LoRA, and nucleus sampling.

items.title: Run End-to-End Post-Training & Quantization Benchmarks
items.detail: Fine-tune a 3B model (SFT + DPO/GRPO), evaluate with lm-eval-harness, and benchmark FP16 vs AWQ/INT4 throughput in vLLM.

items.title: Deep-Read 5 Recent Kyoto NLP Lab Papers
items.detail: Compare research directions across Chu, Murawaki, and Cheng sub-groups to prepare for advisor matching in April.

items.title: Complete First Pass of NeetCode 150
items.detail: Write structured English think-aloud write-ups for core patterns (trees, graphs, DP, sliding window, design).

items.title: Japanese Shadowing & Technical Pitch Scripts
items.detail: Master fluent Japanese explanations of my NJU software engineering projects, motivation, and daily survival logistics.

phases.title: M1 Spring & Summer — Lab Onboarding & Summer Internships
phases.goal: Finalize thesis advisor & research direction, ramp up quickly on lab GPU clusters, and compete for M1 summer internships in Japan.

items.title: Advisor Selection & Initial Research Proposal
items.detail: Choose a high-impact topic at the intersection of LLM algorithms/post-training and scalable systems.

items.title: Apply for Foreign Tech & AI Summer Internships
items.detail: Target Google, Amazon, NVIDIA, Preferred Networks, Woven, and top R&D labs (Hitachi / Toshiba / Sony).

items.title: Pass JLPT N1 (July 2027)
items.detail: Secure N1 certification as a clean credential for Japanese enterprise screening while prioritizing real spoken fluency.

phases.title: M1 Fall & Winter — First Top-Venue Submission & Early Recruiting
phases.goal: Aim for a strong first-author submission to ACL / EMNLP / NeurIPS / ICLR and enter early selection pipelines for 2029 new-grad roles.

items.title: Submit First-Author Paper to Top NLP/AI Conference
items.detail: Open-source clean, reproducible experiment code alongside the paper.

items.title: ML Coding & System Design Interview Prep
items.detail: Practice end-to-end ML system design, GPU inference trade-offs, and behavioral stories in English and Japanese.

phases.title: M2 — Full-Time Offers & Master's Thesis
phases.goal: Secure a strong full-time AI Algorithm / MLE / SWE offer in Japan (foreign tech, global semiconductor, or premier Japanese R&D) and complete Master's thesis.

items.title: Convert Internship or Clear New-Grad Final Loops
items.detail: Evaluate offers across global tech, semiconductor AI teams, and premier Japanese R&D divisions.

items.title: Master's Thesis Defense & Graduation
items.detail: Wrap up research deliverables cleanly and transition into full-time industry work in Japan.
